seoTitle: Pay Raise Calculator: New Salary and Increase
metaDescription: Calculate a new salary after a percentage or fixed raise, with the increase per month, week and hour and the real change after inflation.
intro: New salary and increase per period after a raise.
why:
A 4% raise is a different monthly amount at different salaries. Entering the raise as a percentage or a fixed sum shows what it adds per year, month, week and hour.

Add an inflation figure to see whether the raise beats prices. Figures are gross, before tax.
howTo: Choose percent or fixed amount and enter the raise.

faq.a: Yes. The net effect depends on your tax bands.
Weekly hours times weeks per year, which you can change.
The raise adjusted for the inflation rate you entered.
